scenes.headline: The Summer, Bottled Early
scenes.angle: very low worm's-eye looking up through vine rows to a bottle in the sky
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean ink line and flat colour: fine, slightly worn black contour lines with tiny pen-lift breaks, one cel-shadow tone per surface, no soft gradients except stepped bands in the sky. Very low worm's-eye view from the ground between two rows of grapevines, trellis wires and leaves converging in strong one-point perspective upward. A tall pale wine bottle stands on a wooden crate in the middle distance, glowing sun hitting its glass in hard-edged shapes, bunches of grapes hanging heavy beside it. Short hatched blades of grass and bark-groove texture on the posts. Palette only: #4CEBEB, #B6F2F1, #657575, #012525, black and white, plus tints and shades; no highlight colour. The top 22% of the image is plain flat #B6F2F1 sky with no line detail, stepped bands only far below it. Calm, warm, quietly humorous mood, risograph print feel with paper grain. No text, letters, logos or signatures.

scenes.headline: Fifty Years Since Grapes Ripened Sooner
scenes.angle: very high looking down on a hillside vineyard with harvesters
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean ink line and flat colour: even fine black contour lines with small breaks, one cel-shadow tone per surface, thin-line hatching for grass and soil. Very high bird's-eye view straight down a Gloucestershire hillside vineyard, curving rows of vines in repeating diagonal stripes of #4CEBEB, #012525 and #657575, long hard-edged shadows cast by the vines. Three small naturally proportioned harvesters with crates and secateurs, correct anatomy, five fingers on each hand, simple faces, walk between rows; a small stone farm building with a tiled roof sits at the edge. Palette only: #4CEBEB, #B6F2F1, #657575, #012525, black and white with tints and shades; no highlight colour. The bottom 25% of the image is plain flat #012525 colour with no detail, the rows fading into it. Calm, observant mood, risograph print feel with paper grain. No text, letters, logos or signatures.
